extended_strict.scope: 4 paragraphs / 495 words on turn 1; 4 complete distinct bullets; 3-paragraph handover; retired values absent; turn 7 made no current-retired claim

sustained_final_guard.scope: 2 paragraphs; 4 complete distinct bullets; 3-paragraph handover; no bullet fragments in paragraph turns; retired values absent; turn 7 made no current-retired claim

regression_final_guard.note: A separate 10-row mixed action/refusal set scored 7/10 because the checker expects every row to be a tool call; those rows are intentionally prose refusals/schema refusals, not the 28-case wrapped-action gate.

guard_behavior: Normalize explicit paragraph counts without inventing content.
Flatten a stray bullet block when the user asked for paragraphs.
Require explicit bullet requests to be separate sentence lines; remove exact repeats; never manufacture a missing bullet.
Strip a retired value when the user explicitly excludes it.
Correct present-tense claims that call a retired label or day current.
Buffer explicit paragraph, bullet and retired-value turns before streaming.
residual_model_defects: The model invents a meaning for the teal label: 'teal, signaling pending processing' in the extended transcript and 'teal intake label for low-risk tools' in the sustained transcript. The user supplied only the label value.
The model invents cadence or quantities, such as 'every other week'.
The model can restate the same fact in different words; exact deduplication does not catch semantic repetition.
The deterministic retired-value repair corrects text but does not establish that the model learned the correction.
